name: Cradle Song
source:
Iris and Richie are a perfect matching-- She is beautiful and intelligent; He is kind and talented. But, by a tragic mistake, they are separated with no way back to each other...Richie can no longer see and Iris can no longer hear. Iris only has the fragments of her frail memories to guide her back to a mysterious place where she is no longer the same--

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160316092346/http://pikasite.mew151.net/product.php?id=2]The Subject[/url]]
